description: Ministry of Highways - Declare the Godagama - Kasagala Notional Highway to be an Expressway
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order made under Section 9 of The National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, designating certain national highways as expressways. This constitutes a regulatory action and legal instrument issued under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Kabir Hashim by name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes - the ministerial title is simply stated as part of the legal authority for issuing the order, not as the primary content of the gazette.
